description_for_human: Track your nutrition, meals, water, and weight with AI-powered insights.
description_for_model: CalFlow is a personal nutrition tracking system. Use it to log meals, track water intake, log weight, view nutrition summaries, check nutrition gaps against targets, and get health insights. When a user describes food they ate, use log_meal to record it with estimated nutrition. Use get_today_summary to see their current intake vs targets. Use get_nutrition_gaps to identify what nutrients they need more of.
